messages:
Maya: Hey folks — thinking of a late-week vibe: city arcade + pinball at Quartercade (Midtown) this Friday 7pm? There's a taco + bao truck parked across. Anyone up for it? :video_game: :taco:
Lucas: Love it. Count me in. Can we do 6:30 instead? Quieter earlier for a dinner slot.
Priya: I can do 7. Quick Q — is there accessible seating? My partner needs a table.
Sam: I'm in but only after 8 (have a client call that runs long).
Jenna: Yes yes! Bring quarters? 😂 Also, does company cover late-night rides?
Carlos: I can bring a portable speaker. FYI the food truck takes card. Expect ~$20-35 per person incl. games.
Maya: Good notes. If a bunch prefer 6:30 we can shift. @here quick emoji poll — react :thumbsup: for 7pm, :thumbsdown: for 6:30
Priya: reacted :thumbsup:
Lucas: reacted :thumbsdown:
Sam: reacted :thumbsup:
Jenna: If we split the tab I can Venmo. Also can someone add to calendar?
gcal-bot: Event created: City Arcade Night — Friday, 7:00 PM–10:00 PM at Quartercade (Midtown). Link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd
Maya: Added a tiny poll via bot: `!poll 7pm,6:30` (results so far: 7pm — 3, 6:30 — 1). Looks like final is 7pm. RSVP list: Maya, Lucas, Priya, Sam (arrive ~8), Jenna, Carlos.
Carlos: Cool. If we're >6 I can grab a table.
Jenna: :tada: See you all! Also, post-game karaoke next door? 😂
Maya: :party_parrot: See y'all Friday — I put a note in the calendar about accessible seating and the food truck.
